text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text: Morning, Ines! I see you're full of<n>energy as usual.

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text: Actually, I've got a favor to ask you.

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
I want to put you on a new task. You<n>always do a
great job of things, so<n>I'm leaving this one in your
hands.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back, Ines. Hey, you look<n>happy.
Something good happen?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Well, I got given a really<n>important task
today.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So I'm really happy my manager<n>thinks of me as a
reliable worker. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Congrats! I mean, you're always<n>doing your very
best, so it's no<n>wonder everyone values you!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Teehee. You're going to make me<n>blush saying that
stuff right to my<n>face.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
All righty! Time to prove that my<n>manager was right
to trust me!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After being assigned a difficult job,<n>Ines Fujin
comes away having<n>learned a few new things.
